approach: A hole in a metal sheet expands exactly like a disc of the same metal filling that hole, so its diameter grows by the same linear expansion factor as any length in the sheet.

steps.text: Apply linear expansion to the diameter of the hole, treating it as if it were a solid disc of the same metal.
steps.why_this_step: Every length in the sheet, including the edge of the hole, scales up by the same factor when the sheet is heated.

steps.text: Substitute the given values and evaluate.

common_mistakes.text: Expecting the hole to shrink because the surrounding metal expands inward. Every length in the sheet grows, so the hole grows too.
Using the areal expansion coefficient 2α on the diameter instead of α gives 5.04 cm.

concept_tags: expansion of a hole in a sheet
